nodes.name: customer_segment
nodes.label: Sales segment. Drives most reporting cuts.

nodes.name: Agreement
nodes.label: A commitment between parties, with a lifecycle.

nodes.name: Contract
nodes.label: A negotiated agreement, usually with custom terms.

nodes.name: Currency
nodes.label: An ISO currency. Used to qualify money amounts.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.label: A party that buys. May be a person or an organization.

nodes.name: Employee
nodes.label: Internal actor. Rarely modelled in marts; used for attribution.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.label: Something that happened at a point in time. Immutable.

nodes.name: Interaction
nodes.label: A touchpoint (email, call, session) with a party.

nodes.name: Location
nodes.label: A geography. Country, region, or address.

nodes.name: Organization
nodes.label: A legal entity. Customers may belong to one.

nodes.name: Party
nodes.label: Any actor that can enter into an agreement.

nodes.name: Payment
nodes.label: Movement of money settling an agreement.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.label: A sellable thing. Plans and SKUs are Products.

nodes.name: Refund
nodes.label: Negative movement of money against a prior payment.

nodes.name: Subscription
nodes.label: A recurring agreement with a plan, term and status.

nodes.name: Usage
nodes.label: Metered consumption attributable to an agreement.

nodes.name: crm_customer_sync
nodes.label: Reverse-ETL of customer health back into the CRM.

nodes.name: exec_weekly_dashboard
nodes.label: Weekly exec revenue review. Read by the CFO every Monday.
